reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/linenum.rs owns a static 1024-node pool and anchor/freelist/spare pointers into that pool. Cached positions and line numbers are metadata for the current input, not owners of input bytes.
owner_creation.invariant: Pool nodes remain image storage even while list membership changes.
limitations: No malloc/free lifecycle applies to an individual linenum_info pool element.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/linenum.rs lookup walks raw next/prev links and retains a selected node while scanning input; delayed_msg borrows message text and keeps only a timestamp/type alongside it.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A selected node and message borrow must remain valid until their use ends.
limitations: A numeric file position carries no file-generation identity.

callback_targets.analysis: src/linenum.rs invokes raw-line scanning and diagnostic functions directly; delayed_msg calls ierror with borrowed text and then clears its own message pointer rather than registering a callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Diagnostics must not assume ownership of borrowed delayed-message text.
limitations: Other modules still own input and message allocation lifetimes.

invalidation.analysis: src/linenum.rs clr_linenum rebuilds freelist and anchor state, while add_lnum recycles a spare node by unlinking it. A raw pointer can remain address-valid but refer to a different cached record afterward.
invalidation.invariant: Logical pool-node identity expires when the cache recycles membership.
limitations: Static storage alone does not establish semantic alias validity.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/linenum.rs add_lnum fills a node, links it between neighbors and recalculates gaps through separate writes before selecting a new spare. This is not a staged linked-list transaction.
mutation_commit.invariant: List neighbors, ordering and cache gaps must describe the same commit.
limitations: M0-MEM-001 covers raw metadata coordination without a newly reproduced list defect.

release_pair.analysis: src/linenum.rs returns nodes to internal pool membership rather than freeing them; delayed_msg clears its borrowed pointer after output without freeing message storage. No cached node owns a descriptor.
release_pair.invariant: Pool retirement is logical unlink/reuse, never allocator release.
limitations: The active input descriptor remains owned by the input subsystem.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/linenum.rs failed seek, raw-line sentinel or signal abort returns line number zero; abort_delayed_msg can also disable line numbers and report a message. No local heap allocation is abandoned by those exits.
error_cleanup.invariant: A zero result must be treated as an unavailable mapping, not a valid cached line.
limitations: This review does not classify every lower-layer input sentinel by cause.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/linenum.rs scans poll sigs but still mutate ordinary static pool links and global linenums. Serialized cache use remains an owner precondition, linked to M0-MEM-001.
signals_handoff.invariant: Polling cannot make a half-updated raw list safe for another entry.
limitations: No handler-to-cache mutation trace is asserted by these polling branches.
